zoomProxy.method: Chrome DevTools Protocol Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride sets and verifies innerWidth=320 and innerHeight=900 at deviceScaleFactor=2 before capture; screenshot is 640x1800 physical pixels. This provides 320 CSS px reflow at 2x capture scale, not actual browser UI zoom or text enlargement. A headless extension probe using chrome.tabs.setZoom did not activate in this google-chrome --headless=new harness; the page remained at innerWidth=1440, so 200% browser zoom is unverified.
